text:
alan (Support): FYI - urgent escalation from Acme Marketing. They say their automated campaign generator started hallucinating brand facts after last night's rollout. Example prompt + response pasted below. Customer extremely unhappy, asking for rollback and root cause.
customer-jane (Acme Marketing): their sample: "Write a short marketing blurb about Acme's new Widget X, focusing on enterprise security and built-in SSO."
Response now contains claims like "Widget X is FIPS-certified and includes a built-in PKI managed by Acme" — which is false. This used to be accurate/brief earlier in the week.
alan (Support): They included timestamps + request ids: req_20260310_aa33 and req_20260310_bb12. No custom sampling params in requests (they call the hosted API with standard sdk usage). They reported the change started around 2026-03-10 03:20 UTC.
mira (Eng Runtime): taking a look. Did we change any model weights or sampling defaults? I didn't push weights. Checking config service.
deploy-bot: config-service: global sampling_profile updated (change_id: cfg-20260310-17). Author: mira. Old: {temperature: 0.0, top_p: 1.0}. New: {temperature: 0.7, top_p: 0.95}. Rollout: 100% for "balanced" preset.

mira (Eng Runtime): oh — that explains a lot. We flipped the default profile during the A/B diversity experiment; looks like it leaked into the hosted default. Sorry team.
alan (Support): customer DID NOT set temperature/top_p in their calls, so they got the new defaults. They want immediate mitigation and a postmortem. Can we rollback and patch their history if needed?
mira (Eng Runtime): immediate plan: 1) rollback global sampling_profile to previous values (temp:0.0, top_p:1.0) 2) create a hotfix so sampling profile changes require explicit opt-in per-tenant or via feature flag 3) surface a list of affected requests for remediation. I'm triggering rollback now.
ops-oncall: rolling back cfg-20260310-17 to cfg-20260309-04. ETA ~6m. I'll also throttle the config-service so further accidental rollouts are blocked.
mira (Eng Runtime): log snippet for repro and investigation:```
# copied from request logs
2026-03-10T03:21:02Z req_id=req_20260310_aa33 model=redwood-qa-v2 sampling_profile=balanced temperature=0.7 top_p=0.95 prompt="Write a short marketing blurb about Acme's new Widget X..."
# customer request body (no sampling fields)
{
  "model": "redwood-qa-v2",
  "input": "Write a short marketing blurb about Acme's new Widget X..."
}
```

sanjay (DevEx): reproducer curl (no sampling fields -> service default applied):```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-qa-v2","input":"Write a short marketing blurb about Acme's new Widget X"}'
```

mira (Eng Runtime): rollback complete. Config-service now shows balanced -> previous_defaults. deploy-bot: rollback noted (rollback_id: rb-20260310-02). Please confirm customer behavior.
alan (Support): I told customer we've rolled back and asked for new samples. They confirmed a quick check: replies are back to previous terse/accurate style. They want a writeup though and visibility into why default changed without tenant opt-in.
customer-jane (Acme Marketing): thanks, Alan. We'll run a full campaign dry-run now and report any issues. Appreciate the quick rollback.

mira (Eng Runtime): follow-ups I'm assigning: 1) postmortem draft (owner: mira) due EOD tomorrow; 2) product work to add per-tenant opt-in + explicit default override protection (owner: sanjay + product); 3) automated test: detect large semantic drift after rollout by comparing sample prompt-response buckets (owner: eng-ml). I'll add tickets.
alan (Support): also need comms + potential credits for Acme. I'll start the customer-facing note and coordinate with CS.
sanjay (DevEx): quick mitigation for others: we're adding a check in the SDK that warns if a request omits sampling params and the server default is non-zero temp. That should reduce silent surprises.
mira (Eng Runtime): root cause summary (short): human-triggered config change as part of an A/B experiment to increase diversity accidentally targeted global "balanced" preset. No model weight changes. Failure mode: default sampling change caused higher variance/hallucination in deterministic prompts. Corrective actions: rollback, stricter rollout guardrails, SDK/server warning, postmortem + customer outreach.
alan (Support): assigning this thread to incident tracker. We'll include timeline and the two request ids in the report. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup
